metadata.title: Phase 6B Pre-Submission Verification & Data Consistency Audit

baseline_standard.note: Reported 91.50 is the exact mean of raw floating-point round rewards prior to integer truncation. Integer-truncated mean is 90.90 (-0.60 per round truncation loss).

distributed_cpu_best.note: Reported 91.61 is the exact mean of raw floating-point round rewards prior to integer truncation. Integer-truncated mean is 91.20 (-0.41 per round truncation loss).

arrival_rate_investigation.root_cause: Measurement Definition Discrepancy. highway-env 1.8.2 roundabout-v0 info dict contains only [speed, crashed, action, rewards], with NO arrived key. Phase 6A used info.get("arrived", False), which always returned False (0%). Phase 3A evaluated spatial destination arrival via ("nxs" in vehicle.lane_index) on un-crashed termination, which achieves 26% on Phase 6A seeds (and 31% on Phase 3A seeds). Furthermore, roundabout-v0 duration=11 limits episodes to 11 steps, truncating every non-crashed episode regardless of whether destination was reached.

findings.detail: NN_train.py specifies model.save("YOURMODEL.h5"). To prevent filename mismatch during automated grading, baseline_standard.h5 should be copied or symlinked to YOURMODEL.h5 in the project root.

Teacher original NN_test.py only imports gymnasium as gym without importing highway_env. Without importing highway_env, gym.make("roundabout-v0") will fail. Our final_model_test.py includes this import, but teacher's raw NN_test.py will need it if teacher executes NN_test.py directly.
Teacher NN_test.py line 35 uses return int(total_reward). Both integer-truncated rewards and raw float rewards are now explicitly audited and documented.
